claims.review_note: Preserved exact provenance: official Jan 21 and Jan 26 2026 replies from Gašper Žuber, Information Society Inspectorate, in user-supplied EML. IRSID correspondence says reports by persons and legal entities, including cross-border, by gp.irsid@gov.si or Davčna ulica 1, 1000 Ljubljana, with English accepted; later Jan 26 reply clarifies this is WAD website/app supervision. April 15 reply says no fixed deadline for reports to IRSID and refers to WAD ZDSMA §8 eight-day entity-response deadline. The authority email is not a verified EAA company self-reporting route; Jan 21 specifically said no self-report platform.
